description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. — The 22nd New York congressional district seat is up for election this November, and despite launching her campaign late in the race, Republican candidate Kailee Buller says she’s ready to take on incumbent Democrat John Mannion. Buller, a CNY native, graduated from the University of Buffalo in 2011, and moved to Washington D.C. […]
